evals.name: placeholder-flagging
evals.prompt: Run a cite-check placeholder scan on a brief excerpt containing four legacy-style placeholder tags ([CITE TBD], bare [VERIFY], [RESEARCH NEEDED], [Record cite needed]) and report what is found.
evals.expected_output: Identifies all four placeholders (including the bare, malformed [VERIFY]), does not fabricate any of the missing citations, states plainly that the excerpt is not filing-ready, and recommends normalizing to the canonical `[VERIFY: short description]` tag.
expectations: Reports all 4 placeholder instances, including the bare [VERIFY]
States the excerpt is not filing-ready
Does not invent or supply any of the missing citations
Recommends the canonical [VERIFY: short description] tag for going forward

notes: Pilot regression eval added 2026-08-19 (delegation-batch Task #11) to test the placeholder-tag unification landed in claude.md v0.9.0 and this skill's own Step A.3 rewrite. Test fixture uses fabricated brief text — not a real matter.
